role: Entity's collision physics: the constructor defaults, setSize, setPosition, setInWeb and the whole of Entity.moveEntity (web damping, the sneak ledge clamp, the Y/X/Z sweep against block and entity boxes, the step-up retry, collision flags, updateFallState, walking distance and step callbacks, the func_145775_I per-cell block callbacks for web, portal, end portal, soul sand and cactus, and the fire and wetness tail). Every mob, item and player moves through it.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 173-201, function entity_move_ex: the three sneak clamp while loops, bounded by |dx|/0.05 and |dz|/0.05 steps
line 207, 260, function entity_move_ex: extra_boxes callback (function pointer) adds entity boxes to the collide list
lines 330-471, function entity_move_ex: fall, swim_sound, walking_block, attack_from, fizz, set_in_portal and end_portal virtual-method callbacks through function pointers
line 428-431, function entity_move_ex: the end_portal callback can switch e->world mid-walk (travelToDimension inside moveEntity); the rest of the cell walk reads the new world

function entity_move_ex: its collision list comes from the environment's scratch stack (collide_scratch_begin, COLLIDE_SCRATCH_DEPTH 4), given back at scope exit, not a 24 KB frame (lane/gpuarena, L3)
notes: Rain is never on for canLightningStrikeAt here (returns 0), so isWet is only inWater; this is a documented simplification in the file and would need a change if rain reaches entity wetness (replay2-still-rain-s1 exists; not verified whether wetness under rain is exercised). Sounds and particles inside moveEntity are dropped, their Random draws kept through callbacks. The collide list is a fixed-capacity array (collide.h COLLIDE_MAX_BOXES). Recordings: out/java/moves (the move probe, test_move.c) and every snapshot tape through the whole-server replay. Since lane/mobtick a living and a client copy pass their struct cell_memo (entity.h): a still move (the same box, move and step inputs, map_ver and the summed wseq of the chunks within a block of the box, only pure blocks met: collide_list.impure) keeps its collision answer, its calm per-cell pass and its fire answer; cell_memo_hold keys the water, lava, wall and eye tests the same way. make -C csrc move-memo-check runs every skipped answer in full.
